newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares drop in restricted afternoon trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares drop in restricted afternoon trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi stock Exchange fell sharply in afternoon trade on Thursday on selling by domestic and foreign institutional investors, brokers said.
They said market players were restricting their positions at the end of settlement.
The bourse benchmark index was down 9.60 points, or one percent, to 913.30 at 12:30 p.m. (0700 GMT) after recovering to 924.48 in early trade.
"The activity was confined mostly to squaring-up, and buyers were reluctant to commit themselves to larger positions," said Ramesh Varma of stock broking firm Vijaya Securities.
Reliance Industries was down 0.55 rupee at 371.40 in volatile trading.
TISCO shares were quoted 1.20 rupees lower at 205.
The State Bank of India dropped 3.20 rupees to 319.50 on speculative selling.
Bajaj Auto lost 9.0 rupees to 868 rupees.
Nestle was down 11 rupees at 278 rupees.
Hindustan Lever shed 33 rupees to 1,485 rupees.
